failure-diagnosis.title: Diagnose failure and draft a repair
failure-diagnosis.intro: Inspect fixed failed execution evidence, authorize one read-only model call, then review a repair requirement draft. Diagnosis does not repair, retry or accept the original task.
failure-diagnosis.default_goal: Explain this known failed execution using the fixed evidence and propose a bounded repair requirement with verifiable acceptance criteria.
failure-diagnosis.invalid_locator: Select an exact original run, node and attempt before diagnosing.
failure-diagnosis.invalid_read: The diagnosis response does not match this project and fixed failed attempt.
failure-diagnosis.refresh_failed: Current diagnosis facts could not be read. Your repair draft and reason were kept.
failure-diagnosis.recovery_help: The response is unknown. Recover this exact request and operation key; do not start another model call or duplicate adoption.
failure-diagnosis.existing_requirement: This issue already has a repair requirement. Open the actual record; a diagnosis cannot silently replace its content or create a duplicate.
failure-diagnosis.no_profile: No enabled, currently executable dedicated diagnosis model is available in the loaded page. Load more or configure it in tool settings.
failure-diagnosis.not_health: This is the fixed model configuration, not verified account health. Current admission and actual execution remain separate checks.
failure-diagnosis.budget_help: One model call, up to 8192 output tokens. Existing usage rates, reservations and quota gates apply; token usage is not a vendor bill.
failure-diagnosis.model_ack: I agree to send this goal and the displayed fixed evidence ranges to the configured model for one read-only call.
failure-diagnosis.running_help: The real diagnosis run is in progress. This panel only refreshes its persisted state; it does not submit additional model calls.
failure-diagnosis.unknown_help: Inspect the original diagnosis run and its exact attempt. Unknown output is not a valid diagnosis and does not automatically trigger another call.
failure-diagnosis.basis_changed: The fixed failure basis has changed. Adoption is blocked; keep the original evidence and prepare a new diagnosis if appropriate.
failure-diagnosis.model_proposal_boundar: These are model proposals to verify, including its observations and confidence. They are not proof of a root cause or executable commands.
failure-diagnosis.no_hypotheses: The model returned no additional hypotheses.
failure-diagnosis.criteria_hint: One criterion per line, up to 16. Describe outcomes that can be independently verified.
failure-diagnosis.repair_invalid: Complete the title, description and 1–16 bounded acceptance criteria before saving.
failure-diagnosis.save_first: Save your edited repair draft before adopting it. The model's original proposal remains unchanged.
failure-diagnosis.read_latest: Read latest version and keep this repair draft
failure-diagnosis.draft_ack: I reviewed the saved repair and confirm creating only a draft requirement. Existing issue intake is reused; no task is retried, accepted or marked fixed.
failure-diagnosis.adopted_help: A repair requirement is linked to this issue. Open it to inspect its current state; diagnosis or intake does not mean the failure has been fixed.
failure-diagnosis.original_missing: No complete original output is available; its recorded digest is retained.
failure-diagnosis.evidence_title: Evidence ranges sent to the model
failure-diagnosis.evidence_hint: Only these fixed excerpts are sent. A tail selection is partial; open the original run for the complete evidence.
failure-diagnosis.full_source_hash: Digest of the complete original source bytes
failure-diagnosis.history: Diagnoses for this exact failed attempt
failure-diagnosis.history_empty: No diagnoses have been returned for this exact attempt.
failure-diagnosis.reason.invalid: The failure diagnosis request is invalid.
failure-diagnosis.reason.source: Failure evidence changed. Prepare a new diagnosis before adopting a repair.
failure-diagnosis.reason.uncertain: A current known failed node is required; reconcile the original run first.
failure-diagnosis.reason.issue: The failure issue is not available yet. Wait for the existing failure projection.
failure-diagnosis.reason.profile: Choose a current enabled read-only Suma failure diagnosis profile.
failure-diagnosis.reason.consent: Confirm sending the displayed failure evidence to this configured model.
failure-diagnosis.reason.output: The model output does not satisfy the fixed diagnosis contract. It cannot be adopted as a valid repair.
failure-diagnosis.reason.version: The diagnosis changed. Read the current version before deciding.
failure-diagnosis.reason.draft: Confirm adopting only a draft repair requirement requiring normal delivery review.
failure-diagnosis.reason.failed: The diagnosis execution did not complete successfully.
failure-diagnosis.reason.unknown: The diagnosis outcome is unknown. Inspect the original diagnosis run.
failure-diagnosis.reason.prompt: The fixed diagnosis context exceeds its allowed size. It will not be silently trimmed again.
failure-diagnosis.reason.authority: The original diagnosis creator no longer has current execution authority.
failure-diagnosis.reason.existing: This issue already has a repair requirement. Open that current record.
failure-diagnosis.launcher_help: Read the original run, then choose an actual current failed attempt. No diagnosis or model call starts automatically.
failure-diagnosis.launcher_unknown: This run has an unknown execution outcome; reconcile the original run before diagnosis.
failure-diagnosis.launcher_empty: No current failed or reconciling node with a recorded attempt is available in this run.
failure-diagnosis.launcher_access: Current access to the original run is unavailable. Use an authorized account to refresh.
failure-diagnosis.launcher_invalid_run: The original run could not be verified in this project. Refresh its authorized details.
failure-diagnosis.launcher_issue_loading: Checking the original failed run for this issue…
failure-diagnosis.launcher_issue_empty: This issue has no confirmed link to a failed run.
failure-diagnosis.launcher_issue_invalid: The failed run linked to this issue could not be verified. Refresh to check again.
